description: Use when you need one report on a domain: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA) with SPF and DMARC parsed, RDAP registration for .com, .net and .org (registrar, dates, status, nameservers, DNSSEC). Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /domain/report, $0.005 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For several domains use domain_report_batch; for a single mailbox on the general or email topic server use check_email_address. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

domain.description: domain name, e.g. example.com (a URL is accepted; only its host is used). IP addresses and private or local names are refused

name: domain_report
title: Domain report
